design.title: Magic projectile impact - soft pressure splat A
design.description: The same atonal energy impact, with a rounded contact, gentler crack and grit, and a soft dispersing pressure tail.
design.provenance: Original deterministic synthesis. Direct parameter revision of magic_impact_v4 with its original seed, source layer identities and timings retained; no third-party samples.
design.gameplayTrigger: One existing impact cue for confirmed damaging entity hits and accepted terrain collision; variations do not add surface routing.
design.levelIntent: Approximately 3 dB softer than v4, with reduced upper-mid crack energy and a rounder onset; no musical tail.
